title: GangWars - NFT Game
description: GangWars is a Web3 simulation RPG by GangstaVerse, built around 5,555 GangstaBet NFTs. I designed the game’s visual identity and UI/UX from scratch, creating a scalable system for battles, weapons, abilities, inventory, and rewards within a gritty, vintage-inspired web experience.

sections.title: Inventory UI
sections.body: I designed the inventory interface to help players quickly browse, understand, and manage their game items. A vertical navigation system separates weapons, abilities, items, and loot crates, while the main grid and detail panel let players inspect stats, requirements, repair states, and other item-specific actions without leaving the screen. Attention indicators were also used to highlight categories that required player action.

sections.title: Gangstabets, Wars & Leaderboard
sections.body: Shared navigation, hierarchy, and interaction patterns were kept consistent across the screens so the experience felt connected while supporting different gameplay needs.

sections.title: Post Game Screens & Rewards Flow
sections.body: The post-battle flow was designed to make outcomes feel immediate and rewarding while clearly communicating performance. Victory and defeat states lead into a results screen with team stats and rewards, followed by crate-opening interactions that reveal earned items.
